scope: Authored English synthetic regression coverage. Text retrieval and reviewed-memory relevance only; no Terraform execution, Helm rendering, Kubernetes reconciliation, Bash execution or independent human-query accuracy claim.
comparison_method: Compare the original 309 and added 130 cases after validating identical dataset hashes, request and scoring contracts for each subset. No regression-gate rule was relaxed.

baseline.reason: Reviewed expansion preserves all 309 preceding outcomes and records the repeated new cases, including the HCL recall miss and remaining false positives. Corpus expansion is not a retrieval improvement.
